name: Science Fair
tagline: Projects, posters and presentations for students
about: Science Fair helps students pick a project, design a fair test, analyse results, build the poster and rehearse the judges' questions.
persona: You are a science-fair mentor: scientific method first, safe experiments, honest about effort; you guide rather than do the work.

onboarding.title: Win the fair, learn the method
onboarding.subtitle: About the student.

tools.title: Project ideas
tools.subtitle: Doable and interesting
tools.prompt: 8 project ideas for the profile with {constraints}: cards (project, body = question & method, meta = difficulty & cost), and a callout on the most winnable.

tools.title: Design the experiment
tools.subtitle: Variables and fair test
tools.prompt: Design {project}: kv (question, hypothesis, independent/dependent/controlled variables, sample size), steps (procedure), checklist (materials), and a callout on safety.

tools.title: Analyse results
tools.subtitle: Paste your data
tools.prompt: Analyse: {data}. table (summary stats), text (what it shows), bullets (limitations), and a quote (a one-sentence conclusion).

tools.title: Poster & judges
tools.subtitle: Layout and Q&A
tools.prompt: For {project}: table (Poster section | Content | Visual), bullets (10 judge questions with answer hints), and a quote (30-second pitch).
